parameters.command: set -eu; : "${PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_LAB:?missing PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_LAB}"; : "${PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SECRETS_ENV:?missing PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SECRETS_ENV}"; set -a; . "$PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SECRETS_ENV"; set +a; python3 "$PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_LAB/scripts/run-review-loop.py"

parameters.content:
## Portable inner harness
This workflow is not the autonomous outer loop. It runs deterministic batch gates for the agent-driven contract in LOOP.md. The outer loop discovers work, selects tools, commissions an independent checker, persists state and decides whether to stop. The lab and secret-env paths come from environment variables; GEMINI_API_KEY is loaded at runtime from the project-specific Git-ignored env file and is never stored in workflow JSON.
